games.name: Pears to Pairs Card Game
games.desc:
Welcome to Pears to Pairs, a simple, fun, and hilarious tabletop card game! 🍐

The rules for the game are simple. Each player is given a random set of cards that are objects/phrases. At the start of each round, a judge is selected along with a random card, an adjective. Your goal? Select a card that you think the judge will pair with their card to win! 🏆

With 1500+ different game cards and various game modes, you are sure to come up with crazy card combinations and have endless hours of fun! At least 3 players in a server are needed to play. 🎮

With full device cross compatibility, you can play the game on the go on your phone or tablet. Your cards and win stats also save between all devices and servers. Private servers are free to rent to play specifically with your friends! 📱

Teleporting to a different server = New Update. Shutdown = Emergency Fix.

In this game, it's kill or be killed. This is a fighting game, "randoming" doesn't exist.

Welcome to SoulShatters! There are many planned changes and features that aren't, won't, may, and will be in the final release.

Current Characters Include: Sans, Glitchtale Chara, Storyshift Chara, Undyne, Bete Noire, Asriel Dreemurr, Frisk, XTale Sans/Chara, Delta Sans, Glitchtale Frisk, Sakuya Izayoi, Stevonnie, and Carrot God!

Controls:

[LMB/RMB]: Melee Combat 
[F]: Block 
[R]: Teleport/Transportation 
[Left Control]: Run 
[Double Tapping any Movement Key]: Dash (Instantly makes you run) 
[MMB/L]: Lock/unlock your cursor. (Required for certain moves) 
[1-9]: Special Attacks (Will require Mana) 
[Q/E]: Change modes for certain characters. 

Keep up to date with changes, updates, and planned features.
